title: Add --shout and --times options to the greet CLI
description: greet.py exposes main(argv) which returns the greeting string. Extend main so that `--shout` upper-cases the whole greeting and `--times N` repeats the greeting N times joined by a single space (default 1). Options may appear before or after the name. An invalid --times (not a positive integer) must raise ValueError. Keep the default behaviour unchanged.
